items.prompt: For rows [a,b,c] and [d,e,f], which single output line follows clockwise shrinking-bound traversal?

options.text: a b c d e f
options.why: This is row-major order. After c the traversal descends to f before reading the bottom right-to-left.

options.text: a b c f e d
options.why: Read the top left-to-right, descend the right edge, then cross the bottom right-to-left.

options.text: a d e f c b
options.why: This starts by moving down the left edge instead of taking the declared top-row direction.

options.text: a b c f e d a
options.why: The final a is already emitted. Updated bounds must prevent revisiting the starting corner.
